candidate.answerReason: Non-swans are 75% of all birds, and geese are 30% of all birds, so geese constitute 30/75=40% of the non-swans.

methods.label: Use non-swans as the new whole
methods.explanation:
The requested percentage uses the non-swans as its whole. Since \(25\%\) of all birds were swans, \(100\%-25\%=75\%\) were non-swans.

All geese belong to this group. Comparing their \(30\%\) share of all birds with the \(75\%\) non-swan share gives
\[
\frac{30}{75}=\frac25=0.4=40\%.
\]
Thus \(\boxed{40\%}\) of the non-swans were geese, choice C.
methods.levelReason: The calculation uses an elementary part-to-whole percentage with a changed reference group.
